program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((markers (filter (lambda (m) (!= 0 (snd m)))
                                   (map (lambda (c) (list c (at g 0 c))) (range 0 w))))
                  (objs (filter (lambda (obj) (= 5 (obj-color obj))) (objects g 0))))
             (paint-objects-by g
                               objs
                               (lambda (obj)
                                 (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
                                        (center (fourth bb))
                                        (marker (argmin (lambda (m)
                                                          (abs (- (fst m) center)))
                                                        markers))
                                        (new-color (snd marker)))
                                   new-color)))))))
